title: Ranveer Singh’s ₹300 Crore Zombie Film Just Hired the Prosthetics Team From 28 Days Later
excerpt: Pralay begins shooting next month in Australia, where the Outback doubles for zombie-ravaged Mumbai. Ranveer plans to wrap by Diwali before taking paternity leave — Deepika Padukone is expecting their second child.
body:
The first thing you need to know about *Pralay* is the number: ₹300 crore. That’s the reported budget for **Ranveer Singh’s** next film — a zombie survival thriller that is about to become the most expensive standalone Bollywood movie in recent memory. And they’re not spending it on green screens.

According to a report in *Mid-Day*, the makers of *Pralay* have initiated talks with members of the prosthetics team behind **Danny Boyle’s** legendary 2002 horror film *28 Days Later*. The names in the conversation include **Lisa Crawley**, **Adrian Getley**, **Barrie Gower**, and **Kate Hill** — artists whose work helped define the look of modern cinematic zombies. If the deal closes, it would mark one of the most significant Hollywood-to-Bollywood technical collaborations in the horror genre.

> “Pralay is envisioned as a large-scale survival horror film with extensive practical effects. The makers want those infected by the zombies on screen to look terrifying and convincing.” — Industry source to Mid-Day

The intent is unmistakable: no rubbery masks, no CGI shortcuts. Practical prosthetics, designed by the team that made Cillian Murphy sprint through a deserted London, applied to real actors on real sets.

## Australia Will Become Post-Apocalyptic Mumbai

Director **Jai Mehta** has planned an extensive first schedule in Australia, where the country’s diverse landscapes will double for a zombie-ravaged Mumbai. The story unfolds in India’s financial capital after a catastrophic outbreak — but the production has chosen the Australian outback for its terrain. Think desolation and dust, not Marine Drive. It’s a bold visual bet, and one that signals the film is chasing a global cinematic language rather than a strictly local one.

The screenplay has been co-written by Jai Mehta and **Vishal Kapoor**, best known for the acclaimed web series *Lootere*. While plot details remain fiercely guarded, the film is being positioned as straight survival horror. No *Go Goa Gone*-style comedy cushion. This is meant to terrify.

The project is being produced under **Hansal Mehta’s True Story Films** — the banner behind *Scam 1992* — in collaboration with Ranveer’s own production house, **Ma Kasam Films**. Hansal Mehta has publicly clarified that *Pralay* is an entirely original story, debunking persistent rumours that it was adapted from José Saramago’s novel *Blindness*.

## The Personal Timeline

Here’s where the story turns intimate. According to *Variety India*, Ranveer plans to begin filming next month and shoot through the first schedule until Diwali. After that, the cameras stop — because he’s about to become a father again.

**Deepika Padukone** is reportedly in her third trimester, expecting the couple’s second child after their daughter **Dua**, who was born in 2024. Ranveer has made the conscious decision to take paternity leave after the initial schedule wraps, with production pausing entirely until 2027 so he can be present for his growing family.

It’s a detail that reveals where Ranveer Singh stands right now — at the absolute peak of his commercial firepower, choosing to build his shooting schedule around family rather than release calendars. In an industry that glorifies the grind, it’s a decidedly modern, deeply appealing move.

## Why the Diaspora Should Be Watching

For viewers in the US, UK, and Canada, *Pralay* is worth tracking closely. The international prosthetics team and Australian shoot signal that this film is being crafted with global distribution ambitions. Hindi cinema has dabbled in horror — *Tumbbad*, *Stree*, *Bhool Bhulaiyaa* — but a ₹300 crore zombie epic with Hollywood-grade creature effects and a leading man of Ranveer’s wattage is genuinely unprecedented. If it lands, it could crack open a genre that Bollywood has been nervously circling for decades.

The prosthetics team is expected to be finalised before filming begins. No official release date has been announced, but with a 2027 resumption planned, expect *Pralay* to arrive sometime in late 2027 or 2028.

Until then, Ranveer has zombies to battle and a baby to welcome. Quite the double bill.
